description: Fix field name mismatch between backend and frontend. UserResource returns 'last_login_at' but UserManagementPage.jsx reads 'u.last_login' in the Last Login column render function. Decision: Update the frontend to read 'last_login_at' to match the backend resource (avoids backend change and aligns with Laravel naming convention for timestamp fields).
steps: In resources/js/pages/admin/users/UserManagementPage.jsx, find the columns definition for 'last_login'
Change the render function to read 'last_login_at' instead of 'last_login': (val) => (val ? new Date(val).toLocaleString() : 'Never')
Update resources/js/shared/mocks/manager/users.js to rename 'last_login' to 'last_login_at' in all mock user objects, so mock and API data have the same shape
acceptance_criteria: The Last Login column in the user table displays correctly when using real API data (VITE_DATA_SOURCE=api)
The Last Login column displays correctly when using mock data (VITE_DATA_SOURCE=mocks)
No console errors about undefined 'last_login' or 'last_login_at'
verification: Run the app with VITE_DATA_SOURCE=api and confirm Last Login column shows timestamps or 'Never'
Run the app with VITE_DATA_SOURCE=mocks and confirm Last Login column shows the same format
Inspect a user object in DevTools Network tab response and confirm the field is named 'last_login_at'
